subject: Weekend workshop timing
text: The weekend workshop is still on, but my usual train is delayed and I may arrive late. To keep things moving, our lead can start the planning session at ten. I’ve shared the slides in our folder, and everyone should review them before arriving. If I cannot reach the site by eleven, we will switch to video for the second half. Please bring your project notes so we can stay focused. If the delay becomes serious, I will message you, and we can postpone the brainstorm until Sunday afternoon instead.
